steps.text: 7:10 P.M. \ Clear
Penguin Logistics Base, Messy Room

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: So this is where Penguin Logistics holes up...

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: (It's like a disaster area. And so dark.)

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: It's one of our bases. We haven't cleaned up in a while. Just sit wherever.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Oh, thanks... I realize I didn't properly thank you, any of you.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: We did our jobs. You should introduce yourself first.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: I'm a Messenger, codenamed Bison. I'm from Lungmen, and I work for Mountain Dash Logistics. My father sent me to learn what I can from your company. And I appreciate the opportunity.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Now about the contract between me and Mr. Emperor, I know we've already been over it, but...

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Hold up, little man, I got a question. How'd your bigass daddy raise his boy to be so...

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: ...Boss.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Yeah yeah, go ahead.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Anyway, about that ambush, it was definitely meant to provoke a reaction from MDL and Penguin Logistics.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: We can't take this sitting down. I can contact my father and the LGD. This is a case of aggravated assault...

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Hey, Texas.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: What's for dinner?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: We're throwing a welcome party, of course! But where's Sora? Didn't she stay home to hold down the fort?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Ya know she'll come a-runnin' soon as Texas gets on the horn.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Oh, sorry. You were sayin'?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: (Sora?)

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: ...Um, the first order of business is to figure out who attacked us. Does Penguin Logistics have any leads?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Leads? It's a pretty basic business dispute.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: What do you mean, business dispute...?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Texas! Shouldn't I have a cigar in my hand by now?!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Boss, it's been a while since we shacked up here. I think all your smokes went bad.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Sora came here to clean before. She might have thrown them away.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Y'all for real? You tryin' to kill me? This is wack...

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Yeah, you keep talkin.' Don't worry.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Our first step should be to figure out exactly what these attackers were targeting...

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Hold up, we need some tunes! Get some vinyl spinnin'! We got a whole box of them here, don't we?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Purdy sure I hauled one over. A box worth a couple months' salary.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Found it. What do you want to hear?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Just throw on any one of 'em. Anything I picked out's gonna be fire.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: It ain't life without music. Bless. Nice tunes, nice me.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Bison, what else you got?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: ...Oh. Where was I?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Their target.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Right! Well, their target was me, I guess, to try to provoke our two companies.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: That's it? I figured it'd be some revenge thing...

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: So you have a lead?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Sigh. Texas! Go scout 'em out!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Triple overtime.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Um, we get into scuffles like that maybe twenty times a month. Doesn't every Messenger deal with this all the time?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: ...Why?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Messengers should be quieter, quicker... you shouldn't be settling everything with violence all the time.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Huh.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: We're a logistics company. Why are we always getting involved in gang wars?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: cause they got no taste. They don't value their own lives.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: And the baws signs our checks. We still get the goods where they need to go, all nice an' legal-like.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: It's just we usually end up doin' some armed transport.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Yeah. Like, what's the big deal?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Umm...? You're really okay with that?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Wait a minute.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Here, it's the passcode Sora left.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: C- cookies?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Aww, why'd she open them and leave them here. They're no good when they get all soggy.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: The chocolate side is long, and the tail is short. That's the passcode.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: (That's some weird cryptography...)

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Really? She wasn't kiddin' with that?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: ...All I did was memorize what Sora said.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: 'Suspect.' Hm. Maybe she chased them out.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Let her go. It's quittin' time.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: And we got Sauin, so no overtime. Forget about capitalist oppression. We gotta pour one out for the homies.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Who's drinkin' with me?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Ooh, you buyin', baws? I heard some new top shelf booze just came in stock~

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: S'all good. You ladies got a lotta pay to dock, after all.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: No thanks!

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Wait! We... we never came up with a plan.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Don't need one.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: We just let the mob get away with this?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Play it by ear.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: ...The LGD won't butt in?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Probably not. They're used to this stuff.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: It is what it is. Just go with the flow.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: But last month's property damage invoice was a little longer than usual. You all need to be more careful.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: So what's your typical work like?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: We deliver the cargo in accordance with the contract, and then we fight. But if we have to fight, that kinda takes precedence.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Oh and jobs go to the boss first. Then it's first come first serve, whoever can handle them.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Hey, little man. Your daddy trusted you to me. So you're part of the Penguin Logistics family now, even if it's just for a bit.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Er, yeah... I get it.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: And you gotta remember the first rule of Penguin Logistics: 'Don't sweat the small stuff.'

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Wasn't the first rule 'live for the party' yesterday?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: The one I heard was 'carpe diem.'

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: ...pretty much.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Those ain't gonna be the last soldiers who wanna scoop you up and haul you off, but we're gonna take 'em one at a time. Simple as that.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Hold up, why's my ass feel funny? Somebody leave something in my perfect, ergonomic recliner?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Um, I'll take a look.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Oh, what an adorable little candy box! Boss, you were hiding snacks under your chair!

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: That's cap. Why would I stuff snacks in my... did you say candy box?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: It's a box of candies. See, it says 'Victorian Gumdrops' right here...

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Get back, Exusiai, don't open the——

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Gah! Get down.
